blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers have requested subpoenas for 25 defense witnesses in Duterte’s impeachment trial, the Senate impeachment court confirmed on Thursday. The court said Duterte’s defense team made the request on November 4, 2026 ahead of its presentation of exhibits from November 9 to November 13 on the vice president’s alleged unexplained wealth. According to the impeachment court, the defense is set to call on the legal counsels of businesses linked to Duterte, and her spouse, Atty. Manases Carpio; local government officials accountants from the Davao Region, as well as bank executives. /apl...
